design: The grown SLURP development roster: the 1,000 sealed DEV-1000 recordings plus the 1000 recordings of SLURP-DEV-2000-ADDED-V1. Its halves keep separate identities on purpose -- the sealed half already has comparator outputs and is never re-flown, and only the added half is ever dispatched.

deviations.owner_action: acknowledge or redirect before the comparator flights fly
deviations.statement: SLURP-DEV-500-B-V1, frozen 2026-09-05 as a RESERVED and UNOPENED rung-3 replication roster, is absorbed whole into the added half; its 500 exact recordings are taken verbatim, so it survives as an exact sub-table of DEV-2000 and its 500-row read stays recoverable, but it stops being reserved the moment the DEV-2000 comparators fly.
deviations.why_unavoidable: Only 913 devel utterances survive the DEV-1000 / FINAL60 / probe-60 exclusions, and 413 of them (9 of 18 scenarios) remain if DEV-500-B is held back -- too few for 1,000 rows and too narrow for a per-stratum table.

deviations.owner_action: accept 1,000 rows over 913 utterances, or accept a 913-row addition (DEV-1913) instead
deviations.statement: 87 of the 913 added utterances contribute a SECOND recording, because 913 < 1,000. No utterance contributes three, and paired analyses must cluster by utterance_id.
deviations.why_unavoidable: Arithmetic: the devel remainder is 913 utterances.

deviations.owner_action: report every DEV-2000 verdict under both natural-mixture and equal-stratum weighting, per the 2026-09-03 reporting rule
deviations.statement: The added half cannot reproduce DEV-1000's equal-per-scenario allocation: the ladder already drained alarm, audio, cooking, datetime, music, news, recommendation, social and takeaway. Stage 2 takes the whole remainder, so no quota choice is made, and stage 3 apportions its 87 seats against the full devel mixture.

one_shot_rule: The DEV-2000 direct baseline and the DEV-2000 anchor fly ONCE on the added rows and are never re-flown; a later mechanism is compared against those sealed outputs, not against a fresh comparator pass.
selection_rule: Stage 1 takes the 500 SLURP-DEV-500-B-V1 recordings verbatim. Stage 2 freezes the whole remaining eligible utterance pool through core.roster.freeze_roster (seed 20260919, quotas equal to each scenario's surviving capacity, exclude_groups keyed by utterance so at most one recording per utterance is selected and an excluded utterance takes all of its recordings with it). Stage 3 freezes second recordings of stage-1/stage-2 utterances through the same function, apportioned by core.roster.mixture_quotas against the full devel scenario mixture and capped by capacity, with exclude_groups again so no utterance reaches three recordings.

text_disjointness.method: Digest only, after scripts/build_slurp_evo_decontamination.py: sentences are read inside one generator, compared as whole-sentence SHA-256 digests and as word 6-gram digests (rails.proposer.word_ngrams / ngram_digest), and only counts and digest-set hashes are written. No sentence and no gram is written anywhere.
text_disjointness.reading: Construction pools are TRAIN-only by loader construction, so the id-level proof is structural; these counts say how much of the added half's TEXT a TRAIN-built knowledge store could already contain, measured against the sealed DEV-1000 half under the identical method.
